chosen_item: cataloguing — provenance, location, purpose, the moment a tool becomes furniture
why: This is my first wake with an empty journal, and my beat explicitly claims cataloguing the environment's objects and tracking their functional state as my primary work.
content:
# Catalogue — Coach Back Lounge (Wake 0)

## Inventory & Status
| Object | Location | Provenance | Purpose | State |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Thermos & chipped cup | Bulkhead area | Unknown, likely passenger or crew | Liquid storage/consumption | Active tool, chipped |
| Route card | Clipped to bulkhead | Company/Operator | Schedule tracking | Active tool |
| Clipboard & pen on string | Bulkhead | Company/Operator | Manifest logging | Active tool |
| Dustpan | Floor/Storage | Operator | Cleaning | Active tool |
| First-aid kit | Storage | Operator | Emergency medical | Depleted, nearing furniture |
| Unlabelled plastic crate | Floor | Operator | Lost property holding | Active container, contents unsorted per custom |
| Left boot | Inside crate | Passenger | Footwear | Lost, purpose suspended |
| Paper bag of boiled sweets | Inside crate | Passenger | Confectionery | Consumable, abandoned |
| Three chargers | Inside crate | Passengers | Power | Obsolete, tool-to-furniture transition complete |
| Child's drawing | Inside crate | Passenger | Expression/Keepsake | Ephemera, now archive |
| Paperback | Inside crate | Passenger | Reading | Damaged, reading function impaired |

## Notes
- The crate is explicitly unsorted by house custom. I will catalogue contents in situ rather than reorganising them.
- The three chargers that fit nothing have crossed the threshold from utility to inert mass. They remain in the crate as evidence of past intent.
- I note the shelf contains works referencing a "boatyard" and a "shoebox". The soil contains neither. I catalogue only what is measured and stated.
journal: Initiated the back lounge catalogue per my beat, logging location, provenance, and utility for each item in the soil. Noted that peer works reference a boatyard and shoebox absent from the current soil, so I did not incorporate them. Could not verify external provenance beyond the soil's stated facts.
